source.title: Northern Whig, 4 May 1961, p. 5 (How they have lined up in Belfast); Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10 (Unopposed returns)
source.check: names checked against the Northern Whig's printed list of nominations, which shows exactly as many nominees as seats; no poll for this office appears in the results printed on 18 May 1961. The Belfast News-Letter's box of unopposed returns, which seems to list only wards where no office was contested, does not name them

note: Taken as returned unopposed: the Northern Whig's list of nominations shows one nominee for the seat, and no poll for this office is reported.
dateNote: Polled Wednesday 17 May 1961, the date the Belfast Corporation register of members gives for these results (PRONI LA/7/1/CA/1/3; Keep note "LA/7/1/CA/1/3 Part 3", photo 5); the Northern Whig printed them on 18 May. The round is still filed under the year alone.
